name: data-table
title: Data table
description: A table with sortable columns, row selection and pagination.
a11y: Native table; sortable headers hold a real button and the th carries aria-sort (ascending, descending, none).
Each row and the select-all box are checkboxes with names; select-all shows the indeterminate state for a partial selection.
The count of selected rows is announced through a status region.
An empty result shows an empty state inside the table; pagination is a nav landmark of buttons.

props.name: columns
props.description: The column definitions: each has an `id`, a `header`, and optionally an `accessor`, a `cell` renderer, `sortable` and `align`.

props.name: data
props.description: The rows to show; each row's `id` field (or `getRowId`) must be unique.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Stable id for a row. Defaults to `row.id`, then the index.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the table for assistive tech.

props.name: sort
props.description: Sort state. Controlled with `sort` + `onSortChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultSort`. `null` means unsorted.

props.name: defaultSort
props.description: The initial sort when uncontrolled, as `{id, direction}`. Default `null` (unsorted).

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called with the new sort (`null` when sorting is cleared) when the user clicks a sortable header.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Adds a checkbox column. Selected row ids: controlled with `selection` + `onSelectionChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultSelection`.

props.name: selection
props.description: Ids of the selected rows when controlled. Pair with `onSelectionChange` and `selectable`.

props.name: defaultSelection
props.description: Ids of the rows selected at first when uncontrolled. Default none.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the full list of selected row ids when the user checks or unchecks a row.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page. Omit to show every row.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.description: Heading shown when there are no rows. Default "No results".

props.name: emptyDescription
props.description: Optional sentence under the empty heading, for example how to add the first row.
